usedFor: Membrain holds contacts, companies and opportunities, and Hastewire receives their text to polish through “Humanize Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Activity Created” in Membrain, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: Activity notes are written fast, and the action rewrites them so they sound natural.

watchOut: Triggers from Membrain are polling, so “Humanize Text” in Hastewire runs after a scheduled check.
